title: Gay L NDE 4451
content: I was to have a routine operation to have a lump removed from my breast. I had a reaction to the drug and lost blood pressure. I was aware of the doctors and nurses working on me at the time, I had a warm feeling and saw God. It was not a face only a bright, bright light. I asked God if I was dying, and when he only held me and did not answer me I knew that I was not going to die at that time. It was the most comforting time I have ever felt. I was not afraid in the least, I had no desire to go, but on the other hand no desire to stay. I saw one of my children and my dog who were at my home at the time. I was told that it was all caused by a reaction to the drug used to put me under for the operation.

elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness I was always conscious of everything going on.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was always conscious of everything going on.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes My daughter and my pet dog, who were at my house at the time, I assume I was telling them goodbye, but I don't know why else.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt the most warm and comforting place I have ever felt.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I saw the face of God, as it was not a human face, I know it was God.

elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I shared it with my friend who picked me up and took me home, then my children and family.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real As I was blessed by the presence of God, and know what will happen after I die, the beauty and comfort.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real Not one thing has changed from my memory.
